efxpt:issue.message: Enable phase shift with odd output clock divider will result in duty cycle distortion on the output clock. It is not advisable to use the clock for double data operation: i_mipi_txc_sclk,i_mipi_txd_sclk
These HSIO GPIO must be placed at least 1 pair away from LVDS tmds_tx_clk in order to avoid noise coupling from GPIO to LVDS: GPIOR_P_09
Expected clock phase shift in clock lane mode: Valid Serial(S),Parallel(P) Combinations: (S:135 degree, P:0 degree) OR (S:180 degree, P:90 degree)
Expected clock phase shift in data lane mode: Serial: 45 OR 90 degree, Parallel: 0 degree
Expected clock phase shift in data lane mode: Serial: 45 OR 90 degree, Parallel: 0 degree
Expected clock phase shift in data lane mode: Serial: 45 OR 90 degree, Parallel: 0 degree
Expected clock phase shift in data lane mode: Serial: 45 OR 90 degree, Parallel: 0 degree
